reviewPurpose: Semantically verify that every field of the canonical OVERVIEW row for TM103 is covered by dft-meta.json and dft-conditions.yaml, and that each derived testCondition field is explained by a source locator.
rule: Read the single OVERVIEW row of Dali_testmode.xlsx (plaintext sha256 896770d29f8ae58852e1031c1e6210c5435e52df38e0f6a0fb8fc1836622c04b) and compare rawIntent with testCondition field by field. A source contradiction is preserved as an open item and reported, never resolved. No value may be inferred, no source substituted, no hash re-bound.

fieldChecks.evidence: testCondition.identity copies OVERVIEW columns Item, Level, Name, Description, Purpose and Unit verbatim for the single row whose Item is TM103.
OVERVIEW column Trim is empty for TM103, so the item is not a trim test.
OVERVIEW column Code1 declares vset[vbat,4,100e-6,0] as the static rail and the Power column names VBAT; the 100e-6 ramp slot makes it a direct power-on.
Every vset in OVERVIEW columns Code1 and Code2 uses the 100e-6 direct power-on form, the Test column is Direct and the Dynamic column is empty, so hasRamp is false with no ramp entries.
OVERVIEW column Code2 contains no sweep instruction for TM103, so no ramp is recorded.
OVERVIEW column Dynamic is empty for TM103, so testCondition.dynamicPins is empty.
No OVERVIEW column Name, Description, Notes or Special declares a differential voltage pair, so state is NOT_DECLARED.
No OVERVIEW column Name, Description, Notes or Special declares a high-current mode, so state is NOT_DECLARED.
OVERVIEW columns Code1 and Code2 supply the vset pin names vbat and vdm; the Check column supplies the logical monitor label I(ATEST0), kept as a label and not converted into a physical DUT pin.
OVERVIEW column Check is I(ATEST0) with the Unit column uA, so quantity is CURRENT.
The OVERVIEW Notes and HELPER columns are empty and the Check column asks for a current value, so isToggle is false and the result type is a Measurement.
OVERVIEW column Code2 contains field[(EN_ATEST0,1),(ATEST0_MUX,4)], preserved as register-field intent in source order.
testCondition.referenceValue is the OVERVIEW ExpectValue 0.5 in Unit uA verbatim.
testCondition.expectedValue is the OVERVIEW ExpectValue 0.5 in Unit uA; the de test column reads 0.5uA, which agrees with it.
testCondition.remarks is the empty OVERVIEW Notes column copied verbatim.
testCondition.notes is the empty OVERVIEW Notes column copied verbatim.
